transcript.statement: The sustainability of the RollCall system is crucial for minimizing its environmental impact. GRN-01 promotes energy-efficient algorithms, while GRN-02 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient cloud storage. GRN-03 ensures real-time attendance updates are low-energy, and GRN-04 allows for resource-efficient report generation. GRN-05 raises awareness of the carbon footprint, encouraging responsible usage. GRN-06 aligns data retention with sustainable practices, and GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices. Together, these requirements support a sustainable approach to attendance tracking.

transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness dimension is vital for ensuring that student attendance data is secure and private. TRU-01 mandates encryption of data both at rest and in transit to protect sensitive information. TRU-02 implements role-based access control, ensuring only authorized users can access data. TRU-03 provides an audit log for tracking changes, enhancing accountability. TRU-04 ensures students can only view their records after authentication, reinforcing privacy. TRU-05 guarantees data integrity through checksums, while TRU-06 allows reporting of unauthorized access. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to prevent unauthorized access during inactivity, making the system more secure.

transcript.statement: The Responsibility dimension is essential for ensuring that the RollCall system adheres to ethical standards and regulatory compliance. RES-01 ensures GDPR compliance, protecting student data rights. RES-02 promotes transparency in attendance recording, fostering accountability. RES-03 allows students to dispute attendance records, ensuring fairness. RES-04 ensures that attendance reports maintain student anonymity, safeguarding privacy. RES-05 keeps students informed about their attendance status, enhancing communication. RES-06 restricts data access based on roles to protect sensitive information. RES-07 guarantees compliance with educational regulations for historical data retention. Together, these requirements establish a responsible framework for the RollCall system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes with optimized energy consumption.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy and efficiency.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years using energy-efficient data storage methods.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and ensure efficient resource usage.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input using lightweight processing methods.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users while optimizing resource utilization.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students, ensuring efficient processing.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second, ensuring efficient user experience.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall include a feature to notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit using lightweight algorithms.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles while promoting energy efficiency.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records to ensure accountability.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data by implementing checksums or hashes.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data while promoting energy-efficient practices.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification, promoting accountability.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations, ensuring sustainability.
